articles.title: 340B Program Review: Manufacturer Rebates, Congressional Action, and State Legislation
articles.summary: A comprehensive review of the 340B drug pricing program highlights shifting dynamics involving manufacturer rebate models, legislative activity in Congress, and aggressive state-level regulations. These ongoing legal and policy changes impact pharmacy benefit management and drug cost containment strategies for self-funded employers navigating the 340B landscape.
articles.source_line: Source: JD Supra; Fri, 20 Nov 2026 17:46:23 GMT

articles.title: State Attorneys General to Drive Healthcare and PBM Policy Fights
articles.summary: Newly elected Democratic state attorneys general are poised to ramp up regulatory scrutiny and legal challenges in the healthcare sector. For self-funded employers and PBMs, this signals a potential wave of state-level actions targeting drug pricing, spread pricing, and transparency.

articles.title: Tennessee Regulators Investigate Undisclosed $1.6M Ad Campaign Targeting PBM Legislation
articles.summary: Tennessee campaign finance regulators are investigating the anonymous source behind a $1.6 million advertising blitz targeting a state pharmacy benefit manager (PBM) bill. This highlights the intense lobbying and dark-money spending surrounding state-level PBM reform and transparency efforts. For self-funded employers and PBMs, it underscores the fierce legislative battles and vested interests colliding over drug pricing regulation at the state level.
articles.source_line: Source: Tennessee Lookout; Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:07:27 GMT

articles.title: AMA Highlights Market Dominance of Vertically Integrated Health Insurers and PBMs
articles.summary: The American Medical Association highlights how the nation's largest health insurers are also the dominant players in the pharmacy benefit management (PBM) industry. This consolidation underscores the vertically integrated market power that self-funded employers navigate when structuring their pharmacy benefits and evaluating pricing transparency.
articles.source_line: Source: American Medical Association | AMA; Fri, 20 Nov 2026 13:00:00 GMT

articles.title: Rethinking Pharmacy Benefits: A Strategic Approach for Employers
articles.summary: Employers are increasingly re-evaluating their pharmacy benefit management strategies to gain better control over escalating drug costs. The article highlights the growing need for self-funded plan sponsors to adopt more transparent, cost-effective models to manage specialty drug spend and rebates. This underscores the shifting employer demand toward alternative PBM solutions that prioritize alignment and transparency.
articles.source_line: Source: The Business Journals; Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:50:00 GMT

articles.title: Senators Introduce Bipartisan Legislation to Expand Biosimilar Access and Lower Costs
articles.summary: Senators Bennet and Cornyn have introduced a new bill aimed at increasing the adoption of lower-cost biosimilars to reduce overall prescription drug spending. This federal push aligns with employer and PBM strategies to drive savings through interchangeable biological products.

articles.title: Mark Cuban Slams PBM Contract Complexity as Corporate Exploitation
articles.summary: Mark Cuban criticized traditional healthcare and PBM economics as "contractual terrorism," arguing that even the largest self-funded employers are frequently overcharged due to opaque agreements. The comments highlight growing public scrutiny over complex PBM pricing models and strengthen the market demand for transparent, pass-through pharmacy benefit alternatives.

articles.title: Anthem Faces Proposed Class Action Over Prescription Drug Cost-Sharing Practices
articles.summary: Anthem has been hit with a proposed class action lawsuit challenging its prescription drug cost-sharing methodologies. This litigation highlights increasing legal and financial scrutiny facing health plans and PBMs regarding how out-of-pocket costs and drug pricing are calculated for plan members. For self-funded employers, such legal actions underscore the importance of strict fiduciary oversight, transparent PBM contracts, and audit rights regarding drug pricing flows.
articles.source_line: Source: Bloomberg Law News; Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:58:00 GMT

articles.title: The Future of Obesity Care and Employer Benefit Strategies Beyond GLP-1s
articles.summary: As obesity care evolves past standalone GLP-1 medications, employers are challenged to design comprehensive weight-loss benefit strategies that balance clinical efficacy with cost containment. This shift impacts self-funded plans looking for holistic management approaches to control rising specialty drug spend.
articles.source_line: Source: Drug Topics; Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:14:32 GMT

articles.title: CVS Health Restructures and Breaks Apart Healthcare Conglomerate
articles.summary: CVS Health is dismantling its integrated healthcare empire, which directly impacts the competitive landscape of the PBM and commercial health plan sectors. This major strategic shift will alter how self-funded employers view mega-payer-PBM vertical integration models and market dynamics.
